end.summary:
Practised identifying point, line segment, line and ray by endpoints.
Answered 4 of 5 endpoint questions without help.
Initially said a ray has two endpoints; corrected this later to one endpoint.
Practised ray notation, direction, and counting segments between three points.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised distinguishing points, line segments, lines, and rays using their endpoints. They used the idea of a torch or laser to explain that a ray starts at one point and continues in one direction. There was one mix-up about a ray having two endpoints, and it was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to draw each figure and label its endpoints, then compare ray AB with ray BA.
